purpose: Test-first Node model of the frozen M01 header expectation at the existing get-winner observer

extraction.operation: Each marker occurs once. Select the exact byte interval ending before the next marker. S09-original.txt remains literal input data.

protocol.carrier: AFW_C2_PENDING_GET_RED1_JSON_BASE64 <base64 of the exact LF-terminated UTF-8 result bytes>
protocol.streams: Exactly one LF-terminated UTF-8 JSON frame on child stdout and zero stderr for an admissible RED. Each input pipe is bounded at 4096 bytes. Parent records stdout byte length and SHA256, status, signal, and spawn error.
otherDispositions: UNEXPECTED_FAILURE covers guard, pins, import/syntax, baseline mismatch, wrong assertion, launch cutoff, or incomplete readback.
UNEXPECTED_GREEN means the semantic private-header assertion passed with child exit 0. This is outside RED admission.
The RED-only workflow step always propagates a nonzero status. A failed job without the exact complete feature-missing frame indicates no admitted RED.

isolation.launch: sudo -n to env -i with exactly HOME/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL/NODE_ENV/MODEL_UID/MODEL_GID; timeout; unshare network and PID namespaces; setpriv original nonroot runner UID/GID, clear groups, no-new-privs; Node test file only.
isolation.bound: 8s privileged timeout and 10s outer spawn bound. No product deadline, clock, AbortController, timer or actor is run.
isolation.checks: Child is namespace PID 1, observes no external interfaces, required nonroot IDs, no effective capabilities, no extra groups or environment keys. Parent compares namespace IDs, waits for subprocess, checks the reported host PID is absent, verifies fixed copies and removes only the owned temp files and directory.

inventory.countedBound: At most 14 process/image slots including three serial Git reads, one parent Node and allowance for up to three sudo slots. This is a conservative accounting, independent of the fresh namespaces' checks. No additional target launches were inserted. GitHub checkout/setup/upload and runner infrastructure are outside this one target's process inventory.
